source.licenseEvidence: Original ZIP package.json declares MIT; the ZIP has no standalone LICENSE file. Included LICENSE supplies the Tansr project MIT grant; third-party runtime licenses remain in their npm packages.

adaptedFiles.agent-real.ts: Platform service only, no smoke prompt. SIGINT/SIGTERM use original createDemoShutdown drain + settleResources and preserve failures.
adaptedFiles.launch.mjs: Original package-local env isolation retained; removed automatic dependency updates and app-credential startup precondition.
adaptedFiles.package.json: Preserved original name/version/dependencies/devDependencies/engines. Removed unused client/audio/updater scripts; added single-worker local tests.
adaptedFiles.configure.mjs: Creates missing .env and fills only uniquely assigned empty local secrets. Rejects duplicates/ambiguous syntax before any write; preserves short or placeholder existing secrets and reports configuration_not_ready without rotating them. CLI exits nonzero without a ready message on rejection.
adaptedFiles.developer-login.ts: Original login/refresh contract plus GET /configuration; Host/Origin rejection uses existing forbidden code before ticket issuance or refresh consumption.
adaptedFiles.login-server.ts: Original login server assembly plus safe configuration status.
adaptedFiles..env.example: Platform values may be empty. Local generated auth and explicit serve-only defaults.
adaptedFiles..gitignore: Original excludes retained; additionally ignore .env.tansr-configure-*.tmp and .tansr-configure.lock from shared project configuration.

addedFiles.README.md: Runnable setup, env contract and front/backend wiring.
addedFiles.configuration.ts: Shared local validation: loopback IP listeners only, platform HTTPS root URL (HTTP allowed only for loopback), no URL credentials/query/hash; field-name-only status.
addedFiles.LICENSE: Full Tansr MIT text from skill repository LICENSE.
addedFiles.server.ts: Minimal public factory/store/startServer assembly derived from official agent-real.ts. Missing config uses upstream_unavailable; failed local request guard returns null from public v2.authenticate (original unauthorized response).
addedFiles.starter.test.mjs: OS temporary fixtures and real loopback TCP; covers original auth/configuration behavior, DNS rebinding/foreign Origin denial, and byte-preserving configure rejection for duplicate/ambiguous/invalid existing values. No paid platform or model traffic.
addedFiles.local-request.ts: Local authority and same-service Origin guard. Public Serve 0.15.0 has no Host/Origin option; the guard runs through its existing v2.authenticate hook and original login handlers.

dependencyPolicy: Original package-lock.json is byte-identical. npm ci consumes public npm registry packages; no private source imports and no automatic version update.
exclusions: No source imported from current CLI checkout
No real .env was read or extracted
No echo or fake platform token

protocolBoundary.createSession: Original 503 upstream_unavailable. /api uses unified-v1 top-level code; legacy /v2 uses error.code. Public package owns the HTTP message; missing fields are on configuration/readiness routes.
protocolBoundary.configuration: Login service GET /configuration: status, configured, mode, missingConfig
protocolBoundary.readiness: Original GET /readyz plus public readinessProbes hook, missing application configuration gives 503
protocolBoundary.localIdentityRequests: Loopback Host authority must match actual listener port; Origin may be absent for native clients, otherwise must be same-service HTTP origin. Login/refresh reject with existing 403 forbidden; Serve uses existing authenticate null -> 401, preserving both /api and legacy envelopes.
